lines: Clear water wells up through white stone. It tastes of nothing at all, which up here is a luxury.

sign: Under the salt the old lake still remembers its water. And everyone it swallowed.
raker: Gunda: Halloran pays by the barrel. The barrels don't ask what's in them.
raker_intro: Gunda: You're on company salt. That's trespass. Trespass is a fight.
raker_defeat: Gunda: Go on, then. He's below. He's always below.

lines: Every grain of salt on these flats is mine. You are standing on my money. Wipe your feet.
Halloran: The water's coming back. My salt is going to be worth nothing. You've ruined me. I'll send you a bill.
Halloran: Oriel? She worked for me. Then I sold her. Business. She'd have done the same.

halloran_intro: Every grain of salt on these flats is mine. You are standing on my money. Wipe your feet.
halloran_defeat: Fine. Take the Rift. The salt stays. So do the people buried under it.
